name: finding-unknowns
description: Installs the finding-unknowns skill (templates, an interview you start with /fu-interview, a look-back over past Claude Code sessions with /fu-lookback). The everyday behaviour comes from a separate always-on text (CLAUDE.md, 130 words, appended by install.sh or by hand): before non-trivial changes it shows a four-quadrant map and waits once for your reply (fu:before: KK what you rely on, KU what is open, UK what the assistant assumes you want, UU what you did not ask; "just do it" skips the wait, except for irreversible steps), and after the work it shows what moved (fu:after: expected vs found, now known, not proved, still unknown). Keep your own map of what you know and do not know, and update it only on evidence. No agents or hooks; nothing is written to disk unless you say "save". Release candidate v6.0.0-rc.1 (branch v6).
